title: Powder Snow Warning
body:
## Powder Snow Warning

This resource pack adds a clear warning sign above powder snow blocks, helping players avoid unexpected falls and freezing damage.

![Powder Snow Warning](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RJiBHIMC/images/479bba20d91a310fc569bba87c4d2634a0ecd936.png)

### Why use it
Powder snow can be hard to spot and often leads to accidental falls. This pack gives you a simple visual cue so you can react in time without breaking immersion.

Simple, practical, and effective.
